name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA API coverage, fixed typed SDK reads, design operations and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover control, schematics, PCB layout, libraries, manufacturing, design review and extensions. The facade provides a complete per-method coverage inventory, fixed typed reads with explicit public/native labels, guarded footprint typed API operations, existing-tab activation, inactive clean-tab close, native controls, checkpoints and recovery. Schematic-page, symbol and PCB design transactions plus eight symbol/page/container metadata writers are blocked pending native structure-job completion and full SQL-effect proof; their schemas and historical evidence remain inspectable. Native schematic Text/Wire/Bus ID equivalents avoid public callback/compiler paths. A checkpoint-bound flat topology diagnostic remains separate from the blocked display-only and wire-reroute transaction profiles. Generic compiled topology remains blocked for hidden annotation and Save All; affected exports are refused. PCB navigation rejects known unsafe preference state without changing settings. Bounded observations do not replace complete source, connectivity or saved-project proof. The historical reviewed external tuple is connected-read-admitted; future mismatches fail closed. Historical live evidence remains generation-specific; new adapters need disposable validation. Runtime identity and operation-specific evidence remain mandatory. Arbitrary JavaScript, blind retry and unrestricted Save are refused; the legacy writer is runtime-disabled.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
